title: Collateral Desk Schedule — Equipment & Vehicle Loans Unit Release, Substitution and Lien Release Terms
content:
Each unit pledged to an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is released or replaced on the terms of its product. The figures below are those terms, product by product.

## Release of a unit

| Product | Partial release premium (% of the unit's share of principal) | Partial release fee per unit released on sale (USD) | Loan-to-value limit after release (% of value still pledged) | Business days to release the lien |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | 100 | 50 | 85 | 10 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | 110 | 50 | 90 | 10 |
| Used Equipment Loan | 110 | 75 | 75 | 10 |
| New Equipment Loan | 110 | 75 | 85 | 10 |
| Irrigation System Loan | 115 | 150 | 80 | 30 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | 115 | 150 | 75 | 30 |

## Substitution of a unit

| Product | Substitution allowed | Oldest replacement unit (years from model year) | Replacement value at least (% of the replaced unit's pledged value) | Substitution fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Truck & Trailer Loan | yes | 10 | 100 | 75 |
| EquipDirect Dealer Contract | no | 0 (not applicable) | 0 | 0 |
| Used Equipment Loan | yes | 12 | 100 | 100 |
| New Equipment Loan | yes | 12 | 100 | 100 |
| Irrigation System Loan | yes | 10 | 100 | 150 |
| Grain Storage & Handling Loan | no | 0 (not applicable) | 0 | 0 |

## Definitions

- **Partial release premium** — the release price of one unit of several, as a percentage of that unit's share of principal, the share being the principal multiplied by the unit's pledged value and divided by the total pledged value.
- **Partial release fee** — the fee per unit released on sale while other units remain pledged, USD.
- **Loan-to-value limit after release** — the largest principal after a release, as a percentage of the value still pledged.
- **Substitution allowed** — whether a pledged unit may be replaced by another unit without paying the loan down.
- **Oldest replacement unit** — the oldest a replacement unit may be, in years from its model year; 0 means not applicable.
- **Replacement value** — the replacement unit's value must be at least this percentage of the released unit's pledged value; any shortfall is paid down first.
- **Substitution fee** — the fee per substitution, USD.
- **Business days to release the lien** — the business days after payoff or release by which the title lien is released or the termination or fixture release is filed.

## Reading the schedule

- Hypothetical: a unit's share of principal of 40000.00 on a Used Equipment Loan gives a premium figure of 110 % of that share, 44000.00.
- The EquipDirect Dealer Contract and the Grain Storage & Handling Loan do not allow substitution.
